_comment: Ability effects by ability name (overrides the keyword guess in effects.py). kind: strike (direct damage), dot {damage [min,max], ticks, interval}, heal {amount [min,max]}, buff {stat, bonus, duration}; icon: iconsTK.xml number; cast: cast time in seconds (moving interrupts). Real numbers were server data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md). stance: true makes a buff a maintained stance (no timer, one stance at a time, shown in the Effects Maintained window; right-click there cancels it).
